name: @taste-and-see/worker-analytics-aggregator
description: Analytics search-relevance aggregator worker (TS-217-prep-3b). A scheduled process that, nightly, triggers service-analytics to aggregate the PREVIOUS complete UTC day's raw search.performed + booking.created landing tables into the search-relevance marts (top queries, zero-result rate, searches-per-sort, approximate query→booking conversion) the TS-217 admin dashboard renders. The worker holds no datastore — it makes one shared-secret-pinned internal call per day to POST /api/v1/internal/analytics/search-relevance/compute. Uses a setTimeout cadence loop (the platform's established scheduled-worker idiom — see accounting-metrics / outbox-relay / wellness-summary / identity-janitor), NOT BullMQ: the compute is idempotent + absolute-date keyed so a missed or duplicated tick self-heals. Unlike the accounting-metrics point-in-time snapshot, this worker targets the previous complete UTC day so a full 24h event window is aggregated. PRD §10.1; PDD §5, §23.1, §23.2.
